The primary material of a candle is typically wax (such as paraffin, beeswax, or soy wax).

Regarding the operational processes described in the text, the primary bottleneck is the inefficient layout of the central tool and material repository. The significant travel distances required for workers to retrieve items are causing lost productivity. An efficiency improvement would be to decentralize the storage of tools and materials by placing them closer to the various construction areas, thereby reducing commute time and increasing overall productivity.
